summary: Restarted the Gizmo Pi Web dev server after first terminating stale processes holding ports 5173/8787, then diagnosed and fixed a Windows-specific issue in scripts/dev-server.ts where detached:true caused visible console windows. The fix sets detached to false on win32 so the child relies on unref()+windowsHide; the launcher was edited and verified with prettier/tsc, but the latest launch attempt left the server child process dead immediately.
decisions: On Windows, scripts/dev-server.ts must not use detached:true because it creates a visible console process group; the launcher now uses detached:false on win32 and retains detached:true on POSIX.
The launcher relies on unref() with windowsHide:true on Windows instead of detaching, which keeps the child tied to the parent without opening a new console.
errors: First `pnpm dev:server:restart` reported success but the new process exited because ports 5173/8787 were still held by old PIDs 3068/25404 (and vite showed ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:8787); assistant initially misreported success before verifying.

After killing stale processes and restarting, .gizmo-dev/dev-server.log showed only the startup header and PID 27428 was already dead, while port 5173 returned HTTP 000 (curl exit 7) — the server child terminated immediately and the root cause was not yet resolved before the segment ended.
